subject: Staggered collection onboarding & credit-cap thresholds
messages:
From: Accounts Payable <ap@thermocorp.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@thermocorp.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment cadence & credit cap during onboarding

Hi Marcus,

Following up from yesterday's call — ThermoCorp is ready to move the pilot purchase order forward, but our procurement team needs clarity on the invoicing cadence and any temporary credit cap while we ramp. Current ask from AP: can Redwood provide an initial Net60 window for the first 60 days with a pre-approved credit cap of $150k, then transition to Net30 once we hit steady-state consumption?

We also need a clear VAT routing statement for EU-hosted usage (ThermoCorp EU limited is the billed entity). Please send the invoicing schedule and the format for monthly statements (PDF / CSV) so we can route to our ERP.

Attachments: thermocorp_initial_schedule.xlsx (proposed PO schedule)

Thanks,
Accounts Payable
ThermoCorp Inc.
[Attachment: thermocorp_initial_schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Accounts Payable <ap@thermocorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 17:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment cadence & credit cap during onboarding

Hi — thanks for the clear ask and the spreadsheet. Looping in Laura (Finance) and Priyom (RevOps) to align.

Quick summary of what Redwood can do as a short-term, low-friction approach:
- Temporary onboarding terms: Net60 for the first 60 days with a hard credit cap of $150,000 (as requested).
- Transition: automatic move to Net30 after either (a) cumulative invoices paid > $200k in 90 days OR (b) two consecutive months of on-time payments under Net60.
- Invoicing cadence: monthly invoices on the 1st business day following the calendar month. We can provide both PDF invoice and CSV line item export for ERP ingestion.
- VAT: we will route all EU usage invoices to ThermoCorp EU Limited by VAT ID. Redwood will include VAT breakdown lines and provide a VAT certificate on request.

Action items for ThermoCorp to confirm:
1) Approve the temporary Net60 + $150k cap.
2) Confirm billed legal entity and VAT ID for EU invoices.
3) Provide PO number and the AP contact for ACH/Bank details.

I've attached a short draft of the credit terms we typically use for pilots (redwood_credit_terms_draft.pdf) — it's intentionally minimal and time-bound. If this is acceptable, we can generate a one-page amendment to the MSA and get signatures via DocuSign.

Attachments: redwood_credit_terms_draft.pdf

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_credit_terms_draft.pdf (PDF)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@thermocorp.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Accounts Payable <ap@thermocorp.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment cadence & credit cap during onboarding

Marcus — appreciate the proposal. Two quick clarifications before I sign off internally: 
1) Can the credit cap be tied to usage forecasts rather than a hard dollar ceiling? For example, allow a 25% buffer above the month-of forecast for the ramp, then a review at 60 days.
2) For VAT: ThermoCorp EU Limited VAT ID is GB987654321. Please send the EU invoices to ap-eu@thermocorp.com and copy me.

If Redwood can accept the buffer rule (forecast + 25% buffer) we can provide the PO and expected monthly forecast within 48 hours. Also need ACH details and Redwood's remittance email for quick payment setup.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
CFO, ThermoCorp Inc.
[External: PO and forecast will follow]

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@thermocorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment cadence & credit cap during onboarding

Elena — thanks, that works and is reasonable. Confirming the agreed updates below so Procurement/Legal have a single reference: 

Agreed short-term terms (summary):
- Temporary onboarding window: Net60 for 60 days starting on the first invoice date.
- Credit cap logic: baseline cap = $150,000 OR forecast + 25% buffer for the ramp month, whichever is higher. Redwood will accept the forecast-buffer approach; forecasts should be submitted in the PO/forecast spreadsheet.
- Transition trigger: automatic move to Net30 when either cumulative payments exceed $200k in a 90-day period OR two consecutive months paid on-time under Net60. Redwood will notify 14 days before transition.
- VAT routing: invoices for ThermoCorp EU Limited to ap-eu@thermocorp.com; VAT ID GB987654321. Redwood will include VAT line items and provide a VAT certificate if needed.
- Invoicing: monthly, 1st business day following the month; invoices sent as PDF + CSV line items to AP emails provided.
- Remittance/ACH: Redwood ACH details (sample): Account: Redwood Inference LLC, Bank: Pacific Trust Bank, Routing: 122000021, Account ending: 0921; remit@redwood.ai as remittance contact. (Finance will send formal banking addendum on letterhead.)

Next steps:
1) Elena to share PO + month-by-month forecast (we'll use it to calculate the forecast-buffer cap).
2) Redwood (Laura) will prepare a 1-page amendment to the MSA and a short payment addendum (banking letter) and send for DocuSign.
3) Priyom will create the HubSpot deal entry and note the transition triggers & billing cadence.

If that all sounds right, we'll queue the DocuSign today and expect signatures within 48 hours.

Thanks again — excited to get the pilot live.

Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_credit_terms_draft.pdf (PDF); payment-addendum-letter.docx (to follow)]
